svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Shop data model subtitle: "An order holds many products through its items; a payment settles one order" kind: er # Parents on the left, the tables that point at them to the right: each line runs from the key a # row is looked up by to the foreign key that holds it, and the marks say how many on each end. nodes: customers: fields: - id uuid pk - email text unique - name text - created_at timestamptz products: fields: - id uuid pk - sku text unique - name text - price numeric orders: fields: - id uuid pk - customer_id uuid fk - address_id uuid fk - status text - placed_at timestamptz addresses: fields: - id uuid pk - customer_id uuid fk - line1 text - city text - postcode text null payments: fields: - id uuid pk - order_id uuid fk unique - provider text - paid_at timestamptz null # The join table: orders and products are many to many, one row per product on an order. order_items: fields: - order_id uuid pk fk - product_id uuid pk fk - quantity int - unit_price numeric edges: - customers -- addresses: { card: "1:0..n", label: has } - customers -- orders: { card: "1:0..n", label: places } # Addresses and orders share a column: this line does not set the layers. - addresses -- orders: { card: "1:0..n", label: ships to, constraint: false } # A unique foreign key: at most one payment per order. - orders -- payments: { card: "1:0..1", label: settled by } - orders -- order_items: { card: "1:1..n", label: contains } - products -- order_items: { card: "1:0..n", label: sold as }

svg.title: Shop data model
svg.desc: Shop data model. 6 components. Connections: customers to addresses (has); customers to orders (places); addresses to orders (ships to); orders to payments (settled by); orders to order_items (contains); products to order_items (sold as).

text.tspan: An order holds many products through its items; a payment settles one order
